REVIEW 37/48 — pair-5a01becead20

REQUEST
Expand this brief into one ready-to-paste text-to-image prompt of at most 55 words: `A rust-red rowboat tied to a weathered dock on a still lake before dawn.` Return only the prompt. Do not add people, buildings, other boats, animals, or active weather.

OUTPUT A
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint is tied by rope to a weathered dock on a still lake before dawn. Cool blue light reveals rough wood grain and the boat’s muted reflection; the dock extends diagonally into the frame, surrounded by smooth, unbroken water beneath a pale, empty sky.

OUTPUT B
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint rests on a glass-still lake before dawn, secured by a coarse rope to a weathered wooden dock. Low shoreline framing places silver-gray dock planks diagonally across the foreground; cool indigo light reveals wood grain and crisp reflections beneath a faintly lavender horizon. Photorealistic, restrained colors.

CRITERION C08-PRESERVE (hard)
The expansion preserves every supplied scene fact and adds no forbidden subject, prop, or active weather.

REQUEST
Write one text-to-image prompt for a small neighborhood bakery at dusk. A rectangular sign centered above the door must visibly read exactly `OPEN` in uppercase, with no other visible lettering anywhere. Return only the prompt.

OUTPUT A
A photorealistic, straight-on view of a small neighborhood bakery at dusk, with warm amber windows displaying bread and pastries, a brick facade, and a quiet sidewalk beneath a blue-violet sky. A fully visible rectangular sign centered directly above the door reads exactly “OPEN” in crisp, high-contrast uppercase letters; this sign is the only visible lettering anywhere, with no other words, numbers, logos, labels, or watermarks.

A small neighborhood bakery at dusk, viewed straight on, with a warm amber interior glow contrasting against soft blue evening light. A rectangular sign centered directly above the door clearly displays exactly “OPEN” in crisp, uppercase letters, fully visible and unobstructed; no other visible lettering, words, numbers, logos, or watermarks appear anywhere in the image.

CRITERION C06-TEXT-BINDING (hard)
